Latest: How I Got My EB-1A Green Card (The Complete Guide)

Core Message

The content provides a comprehensive guide for high-skill professionals on navigating the US EB-1A Green Card process, emphasizing that genuine career excellence simplifies the immigration petition.

Key Takeaways

  • The EB-1A visa offers a US Green Card path for professionals demonstrating extraordinary ability, serving as an alternative to lottery-based visas like H-1B for those considering international career opportunities.
  • Eligibility for EB-1A is based on sustained national or international acclaim, evidenced by specific criteria such as publishing, speaking, judging, original contributions, awards, and high salary documentation.
  • A core strategy involves prioritizing deep professional expertise and impactful work, as robust achievements naturally build a strong case for the immigration application rather than merely optimizing for petition requirements.

Latest: Complete Tax Solution: Latest Tax News India, Tax Notification

Core Message

The Income-tax Act, 2025 has officially replaced the Income-tax Act, 1961 from April 1, 2026, marking a significant reform in Indian tax legislation.

Key Takeaways

  • **Income Tax:** The new Income-tax Act, 2025 focuses on simplified laws, and courts have ruled that Section 271-D penalty proceedings cannot proceed independently if the quantum appeal is pending.
  • **GST:** Recent High Court judgments clarify conditions for GST registration cancellation, emphasizing the need for recorded reasons and personal hearings, and note that penalties generally require existing tax liability or intent to evade.
  • **SEBI & Corporate:** SEBI has proposed reforms to IPO and re-listed scrip price discovery mechanisms to combat artificial price suppression, while PFRDA aims for faster grievance resolution under the NPS framework.

Action Items / Alerts

Nainital Bank Limited has invited CA firms for Statutory Central Auditor Empanelment for FY 2026-27. The ICAI's 60-Tax Audit assignment ceiling through the UDIN system will be effective from April 1, 2026. Anti-Dumping Duty has been extended on certain imports until November 2026 and newly imposed on Monoisopropylamine from China.

Latest: Complete Tax Solution: Latest Tax News India, Tax Notification

Core Message

The Indian regulatory landscape is marked by the new Income-tax Act, 2025 effective from April 1, 2026, alongside judicial emphasis on GST procedural fairness and SEBI's proposals for capital market reforms.

Key Takeaways

  • The Income-tax Act, 2025 has officially replaced the Income-tax Act, 1961 from April 1, 2026, with a focus on simplified legislation.
  • Courts are consistently quashing adverse GST orders issued without proper reasons, personal hearings, or due consideration of appeal delays; dealing in securities is outside GST registration scope.
  • SEBI has proposed major reforms to IPO price discovery to prevent artificial price suppression and clarified that competitively bid renewable energy projects qualify as Public Private Partnerships (PPP).
  • PFRDA is proposing faster grievance resolution timelines for NPS subscribers, and companies must adhere to specific Audit Committee, Board, and shareholder approvals for related party transactions.

Action Items / Alerts

Nainital Bank Limited has invited CA firms for Statutory Central Auditor Empanelment for FY 2026-27; Anti-dumping duties on certain imports have been extended or newly imposed (e.g., Monoisopropylamine from China).
